findings.claim_quote: 이 시뮬레이션된 가상 테스트 구성(실제 제품 아님, Virtual2, WSL2)에서 Auto와 Queued 연결의 콜백은 수신 객체의 메인 애플리케이션 스레드에서 실행되었고, Direct 연결의 콜백은 그 스레드와 다른 스레드에서 실행되었습니다. 정지 취소 요청에서 Direct의 콜백 표식은 애플리케이션 stop-enter와 stop-return 사이에 나타났고, Auto와 Queued의 콜백 표식은 stop-return 뒤에 나타났으며, 이는 camera->stop() 앞뒤 애플리케이션 표식 기준이고 연결 간 고정 순서를 뜻하지 않습니다.

findings.condition: 공개 가상 프로브 구성(Virtual2, memfd CPU 버퍼, eventfd 시험 입력, 하드웨어 캡처 입력 시뮬레이션)에 한정된 관찰입니다.
findings.actor: 공개 가상 프로브 실행 하네스와 애플리케이션 콜백 Observer::complete입니다.
findings.timing: 시험 실행 중 관찰된 콜백 디스패치 기록에 한정됩니다.

findings.reason: product-callback-run의 kind, validation_scope, exclusions가 같은 범위를 명시합니다. 원고는 DMA 동기화 미검증과 sync·provider ERROR 줄 보존을 그대로 옮겼고, 관찰 결과를 DMA 정상 동작이나 실기기 검증으로 확대하지 않았습니다. statement_kinds는 behavior이지만 본문이 실행 성공이나 측정 결과를 단정하지 않으므로 소스가 지지하는 범위 진술입니다.

findings.claim_quote: 이 실행은 시뮬레이션된 가상 시험 구성으로, 실제 제품이 아닙니다. 이 실행은 Ubuntu WSL2의 Virtual2 카메라에서 memfd CPU 버퍼와 eventfd 시험 입력을 사용한 가상 프로브입니다. DMA 동기화 및 제공자 ERROR 줄은 보존되었으며, DMA 동기화는 검증되지 않았습니다. 물리 카메라·센서·ISP 캡처, 다른 애플리케이션, 다른 연결 구성, 다른 장치, 사내 HAL도 검증되지 않았으며, 이 콜백 관찰은 DMA 정상 동작이나 실기기 검증 성공을 뜻하지 않습니다.

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: `Request::addBuffer()`는 전달받은 `FrameBuffer` 버퍼에 대한 참조를 `Request`에 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 해당 버퍼가 유효한 상태를 유지하도록 해야 합니다. 버퍼의 유효 기간을 보장하는 책임은 호출자에게 있습니다.

findings.condition: 파이프라인 핸들러가 요청 완료를 알릴 때 completeRequest()를 호출하는 경우입니다.
findings.actor: 파이프라인 핸들러가 호출 의무를 가지며, 애플리케이션은 제출 순서대로 요청을 받습니다.
findings.timing: 호출은 CameraManager 스레드에서 이루어집니다. 반환 후 핸들러는 해당 요청에 접근하면 안 됩니다. 완료된 요청이라면 호출 순서 제약이 없습니다.
findings.scope: completeRequest API 계약입니다. 제출 순서 반환 보장도 이 API 범위에 속합니다. 장치 동작이나 실행 검증은 주장하지 않습니다.
findings.reason: overview/boundary/completion과 request-notice가 모두 CameraManager 스레드 호출, 순서 제약 없는 호출, 제출 순서 반환, 반환 후 접근 금지를 명시하며 원고와 일치합니다. 다만 evidence로 적힌 camera-model/concurrency/completion은 completeBuffer 문서이므로 이 주장의 근거로는 overview/boundary/completion을 따릅니다.

\brief Signal request completion

 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

findings.claim_quote: 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청이 완료되었음을 알리려면 `completeRequest()`를 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출해야 하며, 완료된 요청이라면 순서 제약 없이 호출할 수 있습니다. 이 함수는 요청이 제출 순서대로 애플리케이션에 반환되도록 보장하며, 함수가 반환된 뒤 핸들러는 해당 요청에 접근해서는 안 됩니다.

findings.reason: statement_kinds가 limitation이며 본문은 실행된 콜백 결과가 아니라 검증 전 조사 계획을 기술합니다. 계획 범위가 product-callback-run의 제외 범위와 맞고, 소스의 CameraManager 스레드 의무를 대체하지 않는다고 명시합니다. 실행 결과나 성공을 주장하지 않으므로 적절히 범위가 한정되어 있습니다.

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

findings.claim_quote: `Camera::queueRequest()`는 요청을 캡처 큐에 넣는 데 성공하면 0을 반환합니다. 요청이 큐에 들어간 후 카메라는 `requestCompleted` 신호로 완료를 알립니다.

findings.condition: 완료된 요청에 대해 completeRequest를 호출하는 경우이며, 원문은 이때 호출 순서 제약이 없다고 명시한다.
findings.actor: 파이프라인 핸들러가 completeRequest를 호출하고, 카메라가 요청을 애플리케이션에 반환한다.
findings.timing: 함수 호출 순서와 애플리케이션 반환 순서는 별개의 사건이다. 반환 순서는 제출 순서를 따르고, 호출 순서에는 제약이 없다.
findings.scope: completeRequest의 제출 순서 반환 보장과 호출 순서 무제약 계약에 한정한다.
findings.reason: overview/boundary/completion과 ordering-contract 원문이 제출 순서 반환 보장과 어떤 완료 요청에 대해서도 제약 없이 호출할 수 있다는 점을 함께 명시한다. 한국어 문장이 두 계약을 원문 범위대로 옮겼고 호출 순서와 반환 순서를 구분한다.

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.

findings.claim_quote: completeRequest는 요청을 제출 순서대로 애플리케이션에 반환하도록 보장하는 함수입니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 완료된 요청이면 어떤 요청에 대해서도 completeRequest를 호출할 수 있으며, 이때 호출 순서에 대한 제약은 없습니다.

findings.condition: completeBuffer 또는 completeRequest를 호출하는 상황이며, 요청의 버퍼 부분이 완료되었거나 요청 전체가 완료된 시점이다.
findings.actor: 호출 스레드 요구는 CameraManager 스레드이고, 호출 의무는 파이프라인 핸들러에 있다.
findings.timing: 버퍼 부분 완료 시 completeBuffer를, 요청 완료 시 completeRequest를 호출해야 한다.
findings.scope: 두 함수의 호출 스레드 요구와 파이프라인 핸들러의 호출 의무에 한정한다. 구현이 이를 보장한다는 주장은 아니다.
findings.reason: 두 함수 원문 모두 CameraManager 스레드 호출을 shall로 요구하고, buffer-contract와 request-notice가 버퍼 완료와 요청 완료에 대한 호출 의무를 명시한다. 원문은 버퍼 완료가 자동으로 요청 완료가 되지 않는다고 구분하는데, 주장도 이를 같은 방식으로 유지한다.

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)
{
	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	camera->bufferCompleted.emit(request, buffer);
	return request->_d()->completeBuffer(buffer);
}

/**

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to

 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

findings.claim_quote: completeBuffer와 completeRequest는 모두 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출되어야 합니다. 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청의 버퍼 부분이 완료되면 completeBuffer를 호출해야 하고, 요청이 완료되면 completeRequest를 호출해야 합니다.

findings.condition: registerRequest에서 request의 prepared 신호에 연결된 람다 콜백이 실행되는 경우다.
findings.actor: 람다 콜백이 호출하는 대상 함수는 doQueueRequests이다.
findings.timing: prepared 신호가 발생해 람다가 실행되는 시점이다. 원문 등록 코드는 신호 발생 시점을 정하지 않는다.
findings.scope: 람다가 호출하는 함수 이름만 판정한다. doQueueRequests 내부 동작은 판정하지 않는다.
findings.reason: registration-code 원문이 prepared.connect 람다에서 doQueueRequests를 camera 인자와 함께 호출한다고 명시한다. 주장의 함수 이름과 원문이 일치한다.
findings.claim_quote: `PipelineHandler::registerRequest()`에서 request->`_d()`->prepared 신호에 연결된 람다 콜백이 실제로 호출하는 함수는 doQueueRequests입니다.

findings.condition: pending_ 버퍼에 획득 펜스가 있는 경우와 없는 경우, 그리고 timeout이 0ms가 아니고 대기할 펜스가 있는 경우를 나누어 기술한다.
findings.actor: Request::Private::prepare가 EventNotifier와 Timer를 만들고, 펜스 신호 시 notifierActivated가 호출된다.
findings.timing: 펜스가 없으면 즉시 prepared를 발생시키고 반환한다. 펜스가 신호되면 notifierActivated가 호출된다. timeout이 만료되면 미신호 상태에서 취소와 prepared 발생이 이어진다. Timer는 prepare 호출 시점에 만든다.
findings.scope: prepare의 펜스 대기, 즉시 완료, timeout 취소 분기와 타이머 생성 시점에 한정한다. timeout 핸들러 본문은 발췌에 없어 판정하지 않는다.
findings.reason: prepare 원문 코드의 notifiers_.empty 분기와 timeout 0ms 분기가 주장과 같은 순서로 대응한다. 취소 후 prepared 발생은 원문 doc에 명시되어 있다. 타이머를 prepare 시점에 만드는 이유도 원문 주석의 파이프라인 핸들러 스레드 바인딩과 일치한다.
findings.claim_quote: `Request::Private::prepare`는 `pending_`에 있는 각 `FrameBuffer`의 획득 펜스마다 fd를 읽기 대기하는 `EventNotifier`를 만들어 연결하며, 펜스가 신호되면 notifierActivated가 호출됩니다. 대기할 펜스가 없으면 `notifiers_`가 비어 있게 되므로 `Request::prepared` 신호를 즉시 발생시키고 바로 반환합니다. 선택적 timeout 인자가 0ms가 아니고 대기할 펜스가 있을 때에만 `Timer`를 만들어 timeout 시간으로 시작하며, 만료 시점에 모든 펜스가 올바르게 신호되지 않았다면 `Request`가 취소되고 `Request::prepared` 신호가 발생합니다. 이 타이머는 `Request` 생성자가 아니라 prepare 호출 시점에 만들어지는데, 파이프라인 핸들러 스레드에 바인딩되도록 하기 위해서입니다.

findings.condition: Camera::queueRequest 호출 시점의 카메라 연결 상태와 state_ 값에 따라 isAccessAllowed 반환값이 결정된다.
findings.actor: Camera::queueRequest와 Camera::Private::isAccessAllowed가 행위 주체다.
findings.timing: queueRequest 진입 직후 상태 검사 시점에 반환 여부가 정해진다.
findings.scope: thread-safe 계약, Running 상태 요구, 음수 반환 전달, isAccessAllowed의 ENODEV와 EACCES 분기에 한정한다. allowDisconnected 기본값은 발췌에 없어 판정하지 않는다.
findings.reason: queueRequest doc이 thread-safe와 Running 상태 요구를 명시하고, 코드가 음수 반환을 그대로 전달한다. isAccessAllowed 원문도 연결 끊김 조건의 ENODEV와 상태 불일치의 EACCES를 주장과 같이 반환한다. 영어 대응 번역도 같은 의미이다.
findings.claim_quote: `Camera::queueRequest()`는 캡처를 위해 요청을 카메라에 큐잉하는 함수입니다. 이 함수는 thread-safe 함수로 정의되어 있으며, 카메라가 Running 상태일 때만 호출할 수 있습니다. 함수는 `d->isAccessAllowed(Private::CameraRunning)`의 반환값이 음수이면 그 값을 그대로 반환합니다. `Camera::Private::isAccessAllowed()`는 연결이 끊긴 카메라에서 `allowDisconnected`가 거짓이면 `-ENODEV`를 반환하고, 현재 `state_`가 인자로 받은 상태와 다르면 `-EACCES`를 반환합니다.

findings.condition: 모든 검사를 통과한 경우에만 pipe_의 queueRequest를 큐 연결로 호출하고 0을 반환한다.
findings.actor: Camera::queueRequest가 invokeMethod를 호출하고, 파이프라인 쪽 PipelineHandler::queueRequest가 대상이다. 카메라는 requestCompleted로 완료를 알린다.
findings.timing: ConnectionTypeQueued 호출 후 즉시 0을 반환한다. 요청 완료 통지는 요청이 큐에 들어간 뒤 나중에 requestCompleted 신호로 발생한다.
findings.scope: 반환값 0의 의미가 파이프라인 전달이라는 점과 완료 통지 경로에 한정한다. 파이프라인 실행 스레드나 실행 시점은 판정하지 않는다. analysis 표현은 실행 보장의 근거로 쓰지 않는다.
findings.reason: queueRequest 원문이 d->pipe_->invokeMethod 후 0을 반환하고, camera-model 원문이 큐 등록 뒤 requestCompleted로 완료를 알린다고 명시한다. 주장의 pipe_는 원문의 d->pipe_와 같은 멤버를 가리키므로 생략 철자는 불일치가 아니다. 0을 완료로 해석하지 않는 부분은 반환 순서와 일치한다.
findings.claim_quote: 모든 검사를 통과하면 `Camera::queueRequest()`는 `pipe_->invokeMethod(&PipelineHandler::queueRequest, ConnectionTypeQueued, request)`를 호출한 뒤 `0`을 반환합니다. 따라서 반환값 `0`은 요청이 파이프라인 쪽으로 넘겨졌다는 뜻이며, 요청 완료를 뜻하지는 않습니다. 요청이 큐에 들어간 뒤 카메라는 `requestCompleted` 신호로 완료를 알립니다.

findings.condition: PipelineHandler::queueRequest 진입 후 request를 waitingRequests_에 넣고 prepare(300ms)를 호출한다. Request 준비 실패나 파이프라인 핸들러의 하드웨어 큐잉 실패 시 취소된다는 주석 조건이 원문과 일치한다.
findings.actor: PipelineHandler::queueRequest 구현과 준비 단계를 맡는 Request 객체 및 파이프라인 핸들러.
findings.timing: 함수 본문에서 큐 삽입 후 준비를 시작하는 순서이다. 취소는 준비 단계나 하드웨어 큐잉 실패 시점에 발생한다. 실행 스레드는 CameraManager로 기술되어 있다.
findings.scope: PipelineHandler::queueRequest 주석과 본문이 기술하는 동작 범위이다. 실제 런타임 스레드를 측정한 결과나 콜백 실행 확인은 아니다.
findings.reason: 주석 \context의 CameraManager 스레드 문구, camera->_d()->waitingRequests_ 삽입, request->_d()->prepare(300ms) 호출, 준비 실패와 큐잉 실패 시 취소 조건이 소스와 모두 일치한다. 스레드 문구는 호출 목록이 아니라 소스 주석에서 온 것이므로 paragraph/37의 확정 불가 한계와 충돌하지 않는다.

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

findings.claim_quote: 주석에 따르면 이 함수는 `CameraManager` 스레드에서 호출됩니다. `PipelineHandler::queueRequest`는 `camera->_d()`의 `waitingRequests_`에 `request`를 넣은 뒤, `request->_d()->prepare(300ms)`를 호출해 준비를 시작합니다. 주석은 준비 단계에서 `Request`가 실패하거나 파이프라인 핸들러가 하드웨어 큐잉에 실패하면 요청이 취소된다고 적고 있습니다.

findings.condition: 호출 목록만으로는 조건 분기, 반복 횟수, 실제 실행 스레드를 확정할 수 없다. 가상 호출 후보는 실제 객체에 따라 선택된다. 예약 표시는 인자로 넘긴 메서드 대상을 뜻한다.
findings.actor: 분석 표현(추출기)과 이를 읽는 검토자. 호출부 연결 방식과 동기화 계약을 확인할 주체는 검토자이다.
findings.timing: 정적 추출 시점의 한계이다. 예약된 호출의 실행 시점과 스레드는 큐나 신호 구현이 정한다고 정의에 명시되어 있다.
findings.scope: analysis-representation 범위에 한정된다. 제품 런타임, 콜백 스레드, 하드웨어 동작에 대한 증거가 아니다. 호출부 확인은 실행 결과가 아닌 후속 검증 계획이다.
findings.reason: analysis-definition의 deferred 주석과 trace 정의가 같은 한계를 기술한다. 예약 표시가 비동기 실행을 보증하지 않는다는 문장은 실행 시점과 스레드를 정적으로 알 수 없다는 정의와 맞고 비동기 실행을 주장하지 않는다. 가상 후보 선택은 동적 디스패치 설명과 일치한다. dispatch/1의 CameraManager 스레드 문구와는 출처가 달라 충돌하지 않는다.

sources.source_quote:
An application needs to perform a sequence of operations on a camera before
 * it is ready to process requests. The camera needs to be acquired and
 * configured to prepare the camera for capture. Once started the camera can
 * process requests until it is stopped. When an application is done with a
 * camera, the camera needs to be released.

An application may start and stop a camera multiple times as long as it is
 * not released. The camera may also be reconfigured.

Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.

findings.claim_quote: To prepare for capture, the application must acquire, configure, and then start the camera. Once started, the camera can process requests until it is stopped, and the application must release it when it has finished using it. The application can start and stop the camera multiple times while it remains acquired, and can also reconfigure it. Because the Camera class generally does not synchronize functions that affect the camera state with one another, the caller must synchronize these functions when necessary.

\fn PipelineHandler::match(DeviceEnumerator *enumerator)
 * \brief Match media devices and create camera instances
 * \param[in] enumerator The enumerator providing all media devices found in the
 * system
 *
 * This function is the main entry point of the pipeline handler. It is called
 * by the camera manager with the \a enumerator passed as an argument. It shall
 * acquire from the \a enumerator all the media devices it needs for a single
 * pipeline, create one or multiple Camera instances and register them with the
 * camera manager.
 *
 * If all media devices needed by the pipeline handler are found, they must all
 * be acquired by a call to MediaDevice::acquire(). This function shall then
 * create the corresponding Camera instances, store them internally, and return
 * true. Otherwise it shall not acquire any media device (or shall release all
 * the media devices is has acquired by calling MediaDevice::release()) and
 * return false.
 *
 * If multiple instances of a pipeline are available in the system, the
 * PipelineHandler class will be instantiated once per instance, and its match()
 * function called for every instance. Each call shall acquire media devices for
 * one pipeline instance, until all compatible media devices are exhausted.
 *
 * If this function returns true, a new instance of the pipeline handler will
 * be created and its match() function called.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return true if media devices have been acquired and camera instances
 * created, or false otherwise
 */

findings.claim_quote: PipelineHandler::match() 구현자는 단일 파이프라인에 필요한 모든 미디어 장치를 찾으면 MediaDevice::acquire()를 호출해 장치를 모두 확보한 뒤 해당 Camera 인스턴스를 하나 이상 생성하고 내부에 저장하며 카메라 매니저에 등록한 후 true를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::match() 구현자는 필요한 미디어 장치를 모두 찾지 못한 경우 아직 장치를 확보하지 않았다면 어떤 미디어 장치도 확보해서는 안 되며, 이미 일부를 확보했다면 확보한 장치를 모두 MediaDevice::release()로 해제하고 false를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::match()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출되며, true를 반환하면 새 PipelineHandler 인스턴스가 생성되고 그 인스턴스의 match()가 호출됩니다.

findings.condition: 모든 장치를 찾으면 acquire로 확보하고 Camera를 생성해 등록한 뒤 true를 반환한다. 모두 찾지 못하면 확보 전이면 확보하지 않고, 일부 확보 후면 release 후 false를 반환한다.
findings.actor: PipelineHandler::match() 구현자.
findings.timing: match() 실행 중 장치 확보와 반환 시점이다. true 반환 후 새 인스턴스가 생성되어 match가 호출된다. 호출 스레드는 CameraManager이다.
findings.scope: match() 구현 계약이다. 실제 장치 확보 성공이나 하드웨어 상태 검증은 아니다.
findings.reason: ko 원문과 같은 의무와 금지(must, must not) 표현을 보존한다. 확보 전과 확보 후 실패 처리의 구분, CameraManager 호출 맥락, 새 인스턴스 생성 후 match 재호출이 원문과 일치한다.

\fn PipelineHandler::match(DeviceEnumerator *enumerator)

 * by the camera manager with the \a enumerator passed as an argument. It shall
 * acquire from the \a enumerator all the media devices it needs for a single
 * pipeline, create one or multiple Camera instances and register them with the
 * camera manager.
 *
 * If all media devices needed by the pipeline handler are found, they must all
 * be acquired by a call to MediaDevice::acquire(). This function shall then
 * create the corresponding Camera instances, store them internally, and return
 * true. Otherwise it shall not acquire any media device (or shall release all
 * the media devices is has acquired by calling MediaDevice::release()) and
 * return false.
 *
 * If multiple instances of a pipeline are available in the system, the
 * PipelineHandler class will be instantiated once per instance, and its match()
 * function called for every instance. Each call shall acquire media devices for
 * one pipeline instance, until all compatible media devices are exhausted.
 *
 * If this function returns true, a new instance of the pipeline handler will

 *
 * \return true if media devices have been acquired and camera instances
 * created, or false otherwise
 */

findings.claim_quote: When the PipelineHandler::match() implementer finds all media devices required for a single pipeline, it must call MediaDevice::acquire() to acquire all the devices, then create and store one or more corresponding Camera instances, register them with the camera manager, and return true. If the PipelineHandler::match() implementer cannot find all required media devices and has not yet acquired any devices, it must not acquire any media devices; if it has already acquired some, it must release all acquired devices using MediaDevice::release() and return false. PipelineHandler::match() is called from the CameraManager thread, and if it returns true, a new PipelineHandler instance is created and its match() is called.

findings.condition: 호출자가 roles를 채워 호출한다. 요청한 roles를 충족할 수 있으면 유효한 CameraConfiguration을, 충족할 수 없으면 null 포인터를 반환한다.
findings.actor: 호출자는 roles를 채운다. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() 구현은 반환값 규칙과 스레드 안전성을 갖춘다.
findings.timing: generateConfiguration() 호출 시점이며, 호출은 어떤 스레드에서든 이루어질 수 있다.
findings.scope: PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()의 문서 계약이다. 기본 구성 반환 계약이며, 장치 검증이나 실제 구성 적용 결과가 아니다.
findings.reason: 원문의 호출자 의무(shall populate roles), 반환값 규칙, any thread 호출 가능, threadsafe 요구와 일치한다. 원문의 상태 비변경 조항(shall not modify the state of the camera)은 claim에 없지만, 누락만으로 모순이 되지는 않는다. 호출자 의무와 구현 보장을 구분해 서술했다.

\fn PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()
 * \brief Generate a camera configuration for a specified camera
 * \param[in] camera The camera to generate a default configuration for
 * \param[in] roles A list of stream roles
 *
 * Generate a default configuration for the \a camera for a specified list of
 * stream roles. The caller shall populate the \a roles with the use-cases it
 * wishes to fetch the default configuration for. The returned configuration
 * can then be examined by the caller to learn about the selected streams and
 * their default parameters.
 *
 * The intended companion to this is \a configure() which can be used to change
 * the group of streams parameters.
 *
 * \context This function may be called from any thread and shall be
 * \threadsafe. It shall not modify the state of the \a camera in the pipeline
 * handler.
 *
 * \return A valid CameraConfiguration if the requested roles can be satisfied,
 * or a null pointer otherwise.
 */

findings.claim_quote: generateConfiguration 호출자는 기본 구성을 가져오려는 사용 사례를 roles에 채워야 합니다. generateConfiguration()이 반환하는 구성에는 선택된 스트림과 각 스트림의 기본 파라미터 정보가 포함됩니다. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()은 요청된 roles를 충족할 수 있으면 유효한 CameraConfiguration을 반환해야 하고, 그렇지 않으면 null 포인터를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration()은 어떤 스레드에서든 호출될 수 있으므로, 구현은 스레드 안전성을 갖춰야 합니다.

findings.condition: The caller populates roles. If the requested roles can be satisfied, a valid CameraConfiguration is returned; otherwise a null pointer is returned.
findings.actor: The caller populates roles. The PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() implementation returns the configuration or null and is thread-safe.
findings.timing: At the generateConfiguration() call, which may be made from any thread.
findings.scope: Documented contract of PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration(). It does not establish device verification or the result of applying the configuration.
findings.reason: The translation matches the source obligations, return-value rule, any-thread call allowance, and threadsafe requirement. The ko peer has the same meaning, so no translation drift was found. The omitted state-preservation sentence does not create a contradiction.

 * stream roles. The caller shall populate the \a roles with the use-cases it

 * can then be examined by the caller to learn about the selected streams and
 * their default parameters.

findings.claim_quote: The caller of generateConfiguration must populate roles with the use cases for which it wants to obtain a default configuration. The configuration returned by generateConfiguration() contains the selected streams and information about the default parameters for each stream. PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() must return a valid CameraConfiguration if it can satisfy the requested roles, and otherwise must return a null pointer. Because PipelineHandler::generateConfiguration() may be called from any thread, the implementation must be thread-safe.

\fn PipelineHandler::configure()
 * \brief Configure a group of streams for capture
 * \param[in] camera The camera to configure
 * \param[in] config The camera configurations to setup
 *
 * Configure the specified group of streams for \a camera according to the
 * configuration specified in \a config. The intended caller of this interface
 * is the Camera class which will receive configuration to apply from the
 * application.
 *
 * The configuration is guaranteed to have been validated with
 * CameraConfiguration::validate(). The pipeline handler implementation shall
 * not perform further validation and may rely on any custom field stored in its
 * custom CameraConfiguration derived class.
 *
 * When configuring the camera the pipeline handler shall associate a Stream
 * instance to each StreamConfiguration entry in the CameraConfiguration using
 * the StreamConfiguration::setStream() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 */

findings.claim_quote: PipelineHandler::configure()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출되며, 구현은 성공하면 0을 반환하고 실패하면 음수 오류 코드를 반환해야 합니다.

findings.condition: On success the implementation returns 0; on failure it returns a negative error code.
findings.actor: The PipelineHandler::configure() implementation determines the return value.
findings.timing: At the configure() return, when the call is made on the CameraManager thread.
findings.scope: Return-value and call-thread contract of PipelineHandler::configure(). It does not establish actual device configuration success or hardware state.
findings.reason: The translation matches the source CameraManager-thread context and the return-value rule. The ko peer has the same meaning, so no translation drift was found.

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()
 * \brief Queue a request to the device
 * \param[in] camera The camera to queue the request to
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the device for processing. The
 * request contains a set of buffers associated with streams and a set of
 * parameters. The pipeline handler shall program the device to ensure that the
 * parameters will be applied to the frames captured in the buffers provided in
 * the request.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 */

findings.claim_quote: queueRequestDevice 구현자는 스트림에 연결된 버퍼 집합과 파라미터 집합을 담은 요청을 처리할 때, 요청에 제공된 버퍼에 캡처된 프레임에 해당 파라미터가 적용되도록 장치를 설정해야 합니다. queueRequestDevice 구현자는 성공하면 0을, 실패하면 음수 오류 코드를 반환해야 합니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequestDevice()는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출됩니다.

findings.condition: When processing a request containing stream buffers and parameters, the implementer configures the device so the parameters apply to frames captured into the request buffers. Returns 0 on success or a negative error code on failure.
findings.actor: The queueRequestDevice implementer, that is the pipeline handler, configures the device.
findings.timing: At queueRequestDevice processing, called on the CameraManager thread.
findings.scope: Device queueing contract. It does not establish that parameters were actually applied to captured frames.
findings.reason: The translation matches the source obligation, return-value rule, and CameraManager-thread context. The ko peer has the same meaning, so no translation drift was found.

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

findings.claim_quote: 파이프라인 핸들러는 요청의 버퍼 완료를 알리기 위해 CameraManager 스레드에서 completeBuffer()를 호출해야 합니다. 이 함수는 애플리케이션에 버퍼 완료를 통지하고 요청 내부의 버퍼 추적 정보를 갱신합니다. 마지막 버퍼가 완료되어도 요청은 자동으로 완료되지 않으므로 파이프라인 핸들러는 completeRequest()를 명시적으로 호출해 요청을 완료해야 합니다.

findings.condition: 파이프라인 핸들러가 요청 안의 버퍼 한 개가 완료되었음을 알리는 경우입니다.
findings.actor: 파이프라인 핸들러가 completeBuffer()를 호출합니다.
findings.timing: 버퍼 완료 시점에 호출합니다. 마지막 버퍼 완료 후에도 요청 완료에는 별도의 completeRequest() 호출이 필요합니다.
findings.scope: completeBuffer()의 호출 계약입니다. 버퍼 완료 통지와 버퍼 추적 갱신에 한정되며, 실제 장치 동작은 포함하지 않습니다.
findings.reason: 영문 번역은 원문의 must 의무, 버퍼 완료 통지, 요청 버퍼 추적 갱신, 자동 완료 없음, 명시적 completeRequest() 호출 의무를 원문과 같게 옮깁니다. 소스의 shall 의무 및 CameraManager 스레드 조건과도 일치합니다.

\brief Complete a buffer for a request

 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer

findings.claim_quote: The pipeline handler must call completeBuffer() from the CameraManager thread to signal completion of a request's buffer. This function notifies the application that the buffer has completed and updates the buffer tracking information inside the request. The request is not completed automatically even when the last buffer completes, so the pipeline handler must explicitly call completeRequest() to complete the request.

findings.reason: 영문 번역은 원문의 분기 조건, Threaded와 Isolated 생성 조건, Failed to load proxy 로그 문자열, nullptr 반환, 검증 통과 시 프록시 반환을 그대로 보존합니다. 소스 코드와 일치합니다.

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that

 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in

 * without any ordering constraint.
 *

 */

\brief Signal request completion
 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

findings.claim_quote: After completeRequest returns, the pipeline handler must not access that request, which it no longer manages. The pipeline handler may pass a completed request to completeRequest without any ordering constraint, and this function returns requests to the application in submission order. The pipeline handler must call completeRequest on the CameraManager thread.

findings.condition: 요청에 캡처 버퍼가 최소 한 개 연결되어 있고, 카메라가 Running 상태일 때 queueRequest로 제출한 요청에 대한 설명이다.

 * After allocating the request with createRequest(), the application shall
 * fill it with at least one capture buffer before queuing it. Requests that
 * contain no buffers are invalid and are rejected without being queued.
 *
 * Once the request has been queued, the camera will notify its completion
 * through the \ref requestCompleted signal.
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not running so requests can't be queued
 * \retval -EXDEV The request does not belong to this camera
 * \retval -EINVAL The request is invalid
 * \retval -ENOMEM No buffer memory was available to handle the request

findings.claim_quote: 애플리케이션은 Camera::queueRequest()로 제출하기 전에 createRequest()가 반환한 요청 객체에 캡처 버퍼를 최소 한 개 연결해야 합니다. Camera::queueRequest()로 제출한 요청이 처리를 마치면, 카메라는 requestCompleted 신호로 완료를 알립니다. Camera::queueRequest()는 카메라가 camera_operation에 정의된 Running 상태일 때만 호출할 수 있습니다.

findings.condition: queueRequest 전에 요청에 캡처 버퍼가 최소 한 개 연결되고, 카메라가 Running 상태일 때 제출한 요청에 대한 설명이다.
findings.actor: 애플리케이션이 버퍼 연결과 제출을 수행하고, 카메라가 requestCompleted 신호로 완료를 알린다.
findings.timing: 버퍼 연결과 queueRequest 호출은 제출 전에 일어나고, 완료 알림은 제출한 요청의 처리가 끝난 뒤에 일어난다.
findings.scope: Camera 요청 제출 계약이다. 함수 반환 시점과 요청 완료 시점은 별개로 다루며, 콜백 스레드는 주장하지 않는다.
findings.reason: 원문 의미와 번역이 일치한다. shall, may only be called, requestCompleted 신호 표현의 의무와 제한이 소스의 계약과 같다. 중지 중 취소 경로는 이 문장이 다루지 않으므로 충돌하지 않는다. 이 판정은 계약 요약의 적합성이며 실행 검증이 아니다.

\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

findings.claim_quote: Camera::createRequest() 함수의 주석은 이 함수를 threadsafe로 명시합니다. 이 내용은 주석에 기술된 문서상의 보장입니다. 발췌된 원문에는 함수 본문이 없으므로 구현에서 이를 확인한 것은 아닙니다. queueRequest의 주석은 이 함수가 threadsafe하다고 명시합니다.

findings.condition: Korean claim과 동일하게 threadsafe 표기 자체에 대한 문서 보장으로 한정된다. 상태 조건은 생략되었으며 생략을 보편 조건으로 해석하지 않는다.

\brief Create a request object for the camera
 * \param[in] cookie Opaque cookie for application use
 *
 * This function creates an empty request for the application to fill with
 * buffers and parameters, and queue for capture.
 *
 * The \a cookie is stored in the request and is accessible through the
 * Request::cookie() function at any time. It is typically used by applications
 * to map the request to an external resource in the request completion
 * handler, and is completely opaque to libcamera.
 *
 * The ownership of the returned request is passed to the caller, which is
 * responsible for deleting it. The request may be deleted in the completion
 * handler, or reused after resetting its state with Request::reuse().
 *
 * \context This function is \threadsafe. It may only be called when the camera
 * is in the Configured or Running state as defined in \ref camera_operation.
 *
 * \return A pointer to the newly created request, or nullptr on error
 */
std::unique_ptr<Request> Camera::createRequest(uint64_t cookie)

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

findings.claim_quote: The comment on the Camera::createRequest() function states that this function is threadsafe. This is a documented guarantee stated in the comment. The excerpted source does not include the function body, so this has not been verified in the implementation. The comment on queueRequest states that this function is threadsafe.

\brief Start capture from camera
 * \param[in] controls Controls to be applied before starting the Camera
 *
 * Start the camera capture session, optionally providing a list of controls to
 * apply before starting. Once the camera is started the application can queue
 * requests to the camera to process and return to the application until the
 * capture session is terminated with \a stop().
 *
 * \context This function may only be called when the camera is in the
 * Configured state as defined in \ref camera_operation, and shall be
 * synchronized by the caller with other functions that affect the camera
 * state.
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -ENODEV The camera has been disconnected from the system
 * \retval -EACCES The camera is not in a state where it can be started
 */
int Camera::start(const ControlList *controls)

Functions that affect the camera state as defined below are generally not
 * synchronized with each other by the Camera class. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring their synchronization if necessary.
 *
 * \subsection Camera States

 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that

 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in

findings.claim_quote: Pipeline handlers that call completeRequest() must do so from the CameraManager thread. The \context item of this function specifies the calling thread as the CameraManager thread, and this is a condition the caller must observe. This comment does not specify the thread on which application callbacks run. Camera::requestComplete() passes the completed request to requestCompleted.emit(request) and emits the requestCompleted signal.

\brief Complete a buffer for a request
 * \param[in] request The request the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The buffer that has completed
 *
 * This function shall be called by pipeline handlers to signal completion of
 * the \a buffer part of the \a request. It notifies applications of buffer
 * completion and updates the request's internal buffer tracking. The request
 * is not completed automatically when the last buffer completes to give
 * pipeline handlers a chance to perform any operation that may still be
 * needed. They shall complete requests explicitly with completeRequest().
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 *
 * \return True if all buffers contained in the request have completed, false
 * otherwise
 */
bool PipelineHandler::completeBuffer(Request *request, FrameBuffer *buffer)

findings.claim_quote: A pipeline handler must call completeBuffer on the CameraManager thread when signaling buffer completion. Even when the last buffer completes, the request is not completed automatically, so the handler must explicitly call completeRequest() to complete it.

findings.claim_quote: After completing the request, completeRequest checks the requests in Camera::Private's queuedRequests_ in order, starting from the front. If the status of the front request is RequestPending, the loop stops. Otherwise, completeRequest uses ASSERT to confirm that hasPendingBuffers is false, removes the request from the front of the queue, and returns it to the application with requestComplete. By processing from the front in this way, completeRequest ensures that requests are returned to the application in submission order.

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: Request::addBuffer()는 전달받은 FrameBuffer 버퍼에 대한 참조를 Request에 저장합니다. 호출자는 요청 완료 콜백이 호출될 때까지 해당 버퍼가 유효한 상태를 유지하도록 해야 합니다. 버퍼의 유효 기간을 보장하는 책임은 호출자에게 있습니다.

findings.condition: Request::addBuffer()로 버퍼를 추가한 뒤 요청 완료 콜백이 호출되기까지의 기간.
findings.actor: 호출자(애플리케이션). 버퍼 유효 기간 보장 책임은 호출자에게 있다.
findings.timing: addBuffer 호출 이후부터 요청 완료 콜백 호출 시점까지.
findings.scope: Request::addBuffer의 참조 저장과 호출자 의무에 한정한다. 구현 보장으로 해석하지 않는다.
findings.reason: 영문 번역은 ko 원문과 같은 의무 방향을 유지한다. 참조 저장, 완료 콜백까지 유효 유지, 책임의 호출자 귀속이 buffer-duty 주석과 일치한다.

 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

 * \param[in] request The request that has completed
 *
 * The pipeline handler shall call this function to notify the \a camera that
 * the request has completed. The request is no longer managed by the pipeline
 * handler and shall not be accessed once this function returns.
 *
 * This function ensures that requests will be returned to the application in
 * submission order, the pipeline handler may call it on any complete request
 * without any ordering constraint.
 *
 * \context This function shall be called from the CameraManager thread.

void PipelineHandler::completeRequest

findings.claim_quote: As an investigation plan not yet run, check at the two ASSERT checks at the end of stop() whether queuedRequests_ and waitingRequests_ are empty, and observe whether, without calling stop() again, the later requestSequence_ is set to 0. To signal that a request has completed, the pipeline handler must call completeRequest() from the CameraManager thread; for a request that is already complete, the handler may make that call with no ordering constraint. This function guarantees that requests are returned to the application in submission order, and once this function returns, the handler must not access that request.

findings.condition: 대상 애플리케이션의 연결 위치, 연결 방식, 수신 객체 스레드가 확인되지 않은 검증 전 상태이다.

findings.claim_quote: Execution check item: The connection location, connection method, and receiving object thread of the target application have not been confirmed, so this is a pre-verification state. In further investigation, only the times near the entry and return of the application callback and the execution thread are recorded, and after the camera->requestComplete(req) call, neither status() nor hasPendingBuffers() of req is read. This record neither proves nor substitutes for the obligation to call completeRequest from the CameraManager thread, and observations from the public virtual probe are not generalized to the results of other applications or physical devices.

findings.claim_quote: This public virtual CPU probe was run 3 times, and each run reported 4 RequestComplete and 4 RequestCancelled. Each run had 24 callbacks, which is 8 for each of the 3 connections (auto, direct, queued). The total across the 3 runs is 72 callbacks. This result is a measurement from a simulated virtual test configuration, not an actual product. Request counts are distinct from callback counts and do not mean normal capture or DMA validation success.

findings.condition: 시뮬레이션된 Virtual2, WSL2 구성의 stop-cancel 요청이다. 실제 제품이 아니다.
findings.actor: 수신 객체의 메인 애플리케이션 스레드에서 Auto와 Queued 콜백이 실행되고, Direct 콜백은 다른 스레드에서 실행된다. 스레드 이름은 식별하지 않는다.
findings.timing: Direct의 취소 표식은 애플리케이션 stop-enter와 stop-return 사이에 나타나고, Auto와 Queued의 콜백 진입 및 반환 근처 표식은 stop-return 뒤에 나타난다. 반환 근처 표식은 returned.fetch_add(1)과 지역 객체 소멸 전에 기록된다.
findings.scope: 애플리케이션 표식 기준의 이 구성 측정치다. 연결 간 고정 순서를 뜻하지 않으며, 실제 C++ 함수 반환 완료나 명령 수준 반환 추적을 증명하지 않는다.
findings.reason: 스레드 필드와 stop 관련 불리언 값이 연결별로 모두 일치한다. 소스의 stop-return 뒤 값은 콜백 진입과 반환 근처 표식에, between 값은 취소 표식에 해당한다. 본문은 두 표식 유형을 하나의 콜백 표식으로 묶었지만 연결별 배치는 두 값과 같으므로 충돌하지 않는다. 고정 순서 부정과 반환 증명 부정도 소스 문구와 맞다.

findings.reason: 원문 한국어 항목과 스레드, 표식 순서, 고정 순서 부정, 반환 증명 부정이 모두 일치한다. 소스 기록과도 일치한다.

findings.claim_quote: In this simulated virtual test configuration (not an actual product; Virtual2, WSL2), callbacks for the Auto and Queued connections ran on the receiver object's main application thread, and callbacks for the Direct connection ran on a thread different from that thread. In the stop-cancel request, Direct's callback markers appeared between the application stop-enter and stop-return markers, and Auto's and Queued's callback markers appeared after stop-return. This is based on the application markers before and after camera->stop(), and does not mean a fixed order between connections. The near-return markers are recorded before returned.fetch_add(1) and local object destruction, so they do not prove completion of an actual C++ function return or instruction-level return tracing.

This run is a virtual probe using memfd CPU buffers and eventfd test input on the Virtual2 camera in Ubuntu WSL2. DMA synchronization and provider ERROR lines were retained, and DMA synchronization was not validated. Physical camera, sensor, and ISP capture, other applications, other connection configurations, other devices, and the internal Camera HAL were also not validated, and this callback observation does not mean normal DMA operation or successful validation on an actual device.

findings.timing: 0은 PipelineHandler::queueRequest를 ConnectionTypeQueued로 post한 직후 반환됩니다. 실제 waitingRequests_ 투입과 하드웨어 큐잉은 이후 CameraManager 스레드에서 일어나며, 실패하면 취소로 완료됩니다. requestCompleted는 큐잉 이후에 발생합니다.

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

\fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

Camera::queueRequest() returns 0 if queueing the request to the capture queue succeeds. After the request is queued, the camera notifies completion through the requestCompleted signal.

\brief Add a FrameBuffer with its associated Stream to the Request
 * \param[in] stream The stream the buffer belongs to
 * \param[in] buffer The FrameBuffer to add to the request
 * \param[in] fence The optional fence
 *
 * A reference to the buffer is stored in the request. The caller is responsible
 * for ensuring that the buffer will remain valid until the request complete
 * callback is called.
 *
 * A request can only contain one buffer per stream. If a buffer has already
 * been added to the request for the same stream, this function returns -EEXIST.
 *
 * A Fence can be optionally associated with the \a buffer.
 *
 * When a valid Fence is provided to this function, \a fence is moved to \a
 * buffer and this Request will only be queued to the device once the
 * fences of all its buffers have been correctly signalled. Ownership of the
 * fence will only be taken in case of success, otherwise the fence will
 * be left unmodified.
 *
 * If the \a fence associated with \a buffer isn't signalled, the request will
 * fail after a timeout. The buffer will still contain the fence, which
 * applications must retrieve with FrameBuffer::releaseFence() before the buffer
 * can be reused in another request. Attempting to add a buffer that still
 * contains a fence to a request will result in this function returning -EEXIST.
 *
 * \sa FrameBuffer::releaseFence()
 *
 * \return 0 on success or a negative error code otherwise
 * \retval -EEXIST The request already contains a buffer for the stream
 *  or the buffer still references a fence
 * \retval -EINVAL The buffer does not reference a valid Stream
 */
int Request::addBuffer(const Stream *stream, FrameBuffer *buffer,

findings.claim_quote: Request::Private::prepare creates, for each acquire fence of each FrameBuffer in pending_, an EventNotifier that waits for the fence's fd to become readable and connects it so that notifierActivated is called when the fence is signaled. This function is defined as thread-safe and may be called only when the camera is in the Running state. \fn PipelineHandler::queueRequest()
 * \brief Queue a request
 * \param[in] request The request to queue
 *
 * This function queues a capture request to the pipeline handler for
 * processing. The request is first added to the internal list of waiting
 * requests which have to be prepared to make sure they are ready for being
 * queued to the pipeline handler.
 *
 * The queue of waiting requests is iterated and up to \a
 * maxQueuedRequestsDevice_ prepared requests are passed to the pipeline handler
 * in the same order they have been queued by calling this function.
 *
 * If a Request fails during the preparation phase or if the pipeline handler
 * fails in queuing the request to the hardware the request is cancelled.
 *
 * Keeping track of queued requests ensures automatic completion of all requests
 * when the pipeline handler is stopped with stop(). Request completion shall be
 * signalled by the pipeline handler using the completeRequest() function.
 *
 * \context This function is called from the CameraManager thread.
 */
void PipelineHandler::queueRequest(Request *request)
{
	LIBCAMERA_TRACEPOINT(request_queue, request);

	Camera *camera = request->_d()->camera();
	Camera::Private *data = camera->_d();
	data->waitingRequests_.push(request);

	request->_d()->prepare(300ms);
}

findings.claim_quote: 주석에 따르면 이 함수는 CameraManager 스레드에서 호출됩니다. PipelineHandler::queueRequest는 camera->_d()의 waitingRequests_에 request를 넣은 뒤, request->_d()->prepare(300ms)를 호출해 준비를 시작합니다. 주석은 준비 단계에서 Request가 실패하거나 파이프라인 핸들러가 하드웨어 큐잉에 실패하면 요청이 취소된다고 적고 있습니다.

findings.condition: Request가 준비 단계에서 실패하거나 파이프라인 핸들러가 하드웨어 큐잉에 실패하는 경우에 취소된다는 조건이 원문과 같습니다.
findings.actor: PipelineHandler::queueRequest와 주석이 명시한 CameraManager 스레드 호출 문맥입니다.
findings.timing: queueRequest가 request를 대기 목록에 넣고 prepare(300ms)를 호출한 뒤 준비 단계에서 발생하는 실패 시점입니다.
findings.scope: 소스 주석에 기록된 계약 범위에 한정됩니다. 실제 기기 스레드나 실행 결과에 대한 증거가 아닙니다.
findings.reason: 한국어 원문과 비교하면 주체, 조건문, 스레드 문맥, 취소 결과가 모두 일치합니다. 'According to the comment'로 출처를 밝혀 계약 진술로 한정하고 있습니다.
